name: systematic-debugging
description: Five-phase debugging: REPRODUCE → LOCALIZE → REDUCE → FIX → GUARD. Never guess at the cause. Never fix the symptom. Always add a regression test. Includes root-cause-tracing and defense-in-depth techniques. Inspired by superpowers.

inputs.name: errorOutput
inputs.description: The error message or stack trace.

outputs.name: rootCauseAnalysis
outputs.description: Analysis: errorType, rootCause, affectedFile, affectedLine, reproductionSteps, suggestedFix, confidenceLevel.

outputs.name: regressionTest
outputs.description: The created regression test file path.

failureConditions.signal: reproduction steps fail to trigger the error
